title: Mplus Registration Configuration
description: Configuration schema for multi-metric image registration using itkMplus (v6.0). Field names map to CLI option long names.

mi_deriv.description: MI derivative weight (--alphaderivative). Defaults to mi value

mse_deriv.description: MSE derivative weight (--nuderivative). Defaults to mse value

gd.description: Gradient Difference weight (--rho). Default: 0.0. Sobel-based edge metric; best for singlemodal structural alignment. No subsampling.

nmi.description: Normalized Mutual Information weight (--sigma). Default: 0.0. Histogram-based; robust for multimodal registration. No subsampling.

modality.description: Preset modality (--modality). 'multimodal' sets MI+NGF defaults; 'singlemodal' sets MSE+NC defaults; 'custom' uses manual weights. Default: custom

derivative_mode.description: Derivative merge mode (--derivativemode): 0=consistent weighted sum (default), 1=normalised (RSGD only, blocked for BSplines), 2=main-metric adaptive

main_metric.description: Main metric index for mode 2 (--mainmetric): 0=MI, 1=NGF, 2=MSE, 3=NC, 4=Label, 5=GD, 6=NMI. Default: 0

grid_spacing.description: B-spline control point spacing in mm (--gridresolution). Default: 50.0. Only for BSplines.

mesh_margin.description: Extra margin (mm) around image domain for B-spline mesh (--meshmarginsize). Default: 0.0

num_levels.description: Number of multi-resolution levels (--numberoflevels). Only for AffineMultiLevel. Default: 2

minimum_step_length.description: RSGD minimum step length (--minimumsteplength). Default: 0.1. Similarity/Affine/AffineMultiLevel only.

maximum_step_length.description: RSGD maximum step length (--maximumsteplength). Default: 1.0. Similarity/Affine/AffineMultiLevel only.

cost_function_convergence_factor.description: LBFGS-B convergence factor (--costfunctionconvergencefactor). Default: 1e12. BSplines only.

projected_gradient_tolerance.description: LBFGS-B projected gradient tolerance (--projectedgradienttolerance). Default: 1e-5. BSplines only.

number_of_evaluations.description: Maximum function evaluations (--numberofevaluations). Default: 500. BSplines only.

number_of_corrections.description: LBFGS-B memory size (--numberofcorrections). Default: 5. BSplines only.

fixed_eta.description: NGF noise parameter for fixed image (--etavaluefixed). -1=auto. Default: -1

moving_eta.description: NGF noise parameter for moving image (--etavaluemoving). -1=auto. Default: -1

ngf_spacing.description: NGF finite-difference spacing per axis in mm (--ngfspacing). Default: '4,4,4'

nmi_bins.description: NMI histogram bins (--nmibins). Default: 64. Only used when nmi (--sigma) > 0.

metric_overlap.description: Compute overlap between fixed and moving image (--metricoverlap). Default: true

fixed_image_threshold.description: Only sample fixed voxels above this value (--fixedimagethreshold). Default: -99999999 (disabled)

samples.description: Label metric percentage of pixels used (--labelsamples). Default: 0.1 (10%)

report_every.description: Print Dice every N iterations (--labelreport). 0=off. Default: 1

per_label_weights.description: Per-label kappa weights (--labelkappavec). Keys are label integers.

grid.description: Overlay a warped deformation grid on the registered image panel (--snapshotgrid). Default: true

grid_spacing.description: Grid line spacing in voxels for the deformation grid overlay (--snapshotgridspacing). Default: 20

transform_in.description: Path to an existing transform file to initialise from (--transformin / -W). Accepts any linear ITK transform (e.g. Similarity3DTransform, AffineTransform); auto-converts when the type differs from the executable's native transform. Default: 'N' (identity)
